negatives.claim: BLOSUM62 and ESM2-650M likelihood both rank the resistant residue as benign at catalogued PATHOGEN TARGET-SITE positions ONLY -- HIV-1 RT, SARS-CoV-2 Mpro and fungal ERG11/FKS1
negatives.scope: PATHOGEN TARGET-SITE resistance systems ONLY -- three pathogens, catalogued resistance positions, scored by mid-rank of the resistant residue among the 19 alternatives (pooled 4.5 of 19 vs a null of 10.0, n=139). DRM sites sit at ESM entropy percentile 0.494, i.e. exactly average, which REFUTES the usual 'the site is poorly conserved' account. Friedman 2013 (PLOS ONE 8:e82059) supplies a COUNTEREXAMPLE CLASS: EGFR and ALK resistance mutations tend to be RADICAL, so this must not be stated as a general law.
negatives.revival_condition: a conservation- or likelihood-keyed scorer is tested on a resistance system OUTSIDE pathogen target sites (e.g. kinase-inhibitor resistance), where the published counterexample class lives
negatives.claim_corrected_from: BLOSUM62 and ESM2-650M likelihood both rank the resistant residue as benign at catalogued target sites in HIV-1 RT, SARS-CoV-2 Mpro and fungal ERG11/FKS1
negatives.claim_correction_reason: 2026-10-09 the WIDENED peer detector caught this one: scope said ONLY, claim did not carry it

negatives.claim: FROZEN PlantCaduceus_l32 embeddings, used ZERO-SHOT as fixed features on 1,003 NATURAL Arabidopsis accessions, predict flowering time ONLY at or below a population-structure baseline
negatives.scope: One eukaryote, one trait (FT10), 3 seeds, n=1003 NATURAL accessions -- a natural population, which is the regime this project has measured as closed FOR EVERY ORGANISM. Within-group r-squared was NEGATIVE (-0.13 avg) and spearman 0.22 against a structure-only 0.48, i.e. the embedding learned POPULATION STRUCTURE rather than the causal signal. This is NOT evidence that eukaryotes are harder: the only clean organism-level positive in this project is also a eukaryote (yeast segregant cross, 12/12 traits at r 0.46-0.80) on a CONSTRUCTED panel.
negatives.revival_condition: a learned representation is tested on a constructed panel WHERE THE MARKERS ARE NOT A SUFFICIENT STATISTIC -- i.e. a mutagenesis library or a multi-parent/novel-allele panel, NOT a bi-parental cross. On a bi-parental cross the +/-1 marker already encodes allele identity, so a sequence model is EXPECTED TO TIE by construction and a tie would revive nothing (scripts/yeast_bloom_fm_prep.py states this prior explicitly).
negatives.revival_condition_corrected_from: a learned representation is tested on a CONSTRUCTED eukaryotic panel (a segregant cross, a MAGIC/NAM population, or a mutagenesis library) where ancestry is randomised by design rather than on natural accessions
negatives.revival_correction_reason: 2026-10-09 re-assessment: the original revival said 'a CONSTRUCTED eukaryotic panel', which is satisfiable on a bi-parental cross where the result is a foregone tie. A revival condition that can be met uninformatively is not a revival condition.

negatives.claim: A CURATED-DETERMINANT alphabet beats a FIXED TOP-N K-MER VOCABULARY on 5 drugs (p<0.0001) -- a comparison in which NO learned representation was trained
negatives.scope: The losing arm was a FIXED top-N-most-frequent k-mer vocabulary used as the stand-in for a learned representation; the probe TRAINED NOTHING ('neural #3' appears once in the closeout, as the thing not done). The same document explains WHY that arm lost: the top-N k-mer vocab IS the core genome, so it misses signal WITHIN a lineage -- a VOCABULARY-CONSTRUCTION failure, not a learning failure. Headroom was also measured only on mechanisms the catalog already covers, while the project's own doubt layer later located the catalog's real gap as COMPLETENESS (V179F: 15/15 carriers resistant, rule says S) -- exactly where a learned model would earn its keep, and exactly where this probe never looked.
negatives.revival_condition: a learned representation is ACTUALLY TRAINED on raw sequence and compared to the curated alphabet, scored on the catalog's COMPLETENESS gap rather than on mechanisms the catalog already covers

negatives.claim: FROZEN pretrained nucleotide embeddings, used ZERO-SHOT as FIXED FEATURES on NATURAL populations, fail de-confounded organism-level g->p prediction (0-for-5)
negatives.scope: FIVE instantiations, all sharing the SAME four qualifiers: frozen weights, zero-shot, used as fixed features, and scored on NATURAL populations with a de-confounding control (within-lineage or within-group). Instances span bacteria (cipro within-lineage), pathotype, Arabidopsis flowering time, and dog/Drosophila panels. NONE of the five fine-tuned anything, and NONE used a constructed panel. This was originally filed as 'a MODEL ceiling' -- a claim about the whole class -- and that wording cost ~4 months.
negatives.revival_condition: any of the four shared qualifiers is broken IN AN INFORMATIVE WAY: a FINE-TUNED representation; a learned head rather than fixed features; or a CONSTRUCTED panel whose markers are NOT a sufficient statistic (mutagenesis / multi-parent / novel-allele -- NOT a bi-parental cross, where a sequence model is expected to tie by construction).
negatives.revival_condition_corrected_from: any of the four shared qualifiers is broken: a FINE-TUNED representation, or a CONSTRUCTED panel where ancestry is randomised by design (the yeast segregant cross is the measured positive in this class), or a learned head rather than fixed features
negatives.revival_correction_reason: 2026-10-09: same defect as the Arabidopsis record -- 'a constructed panel' alone is satisfiable uninformatively on a bi-parental cross.

negatives.claim: GREEDY-REPRESENTATIVE Mash clustering produces a usable lineage partition for M. TUBERCULOSIS ONLY -- 0 of 8 threshold rungs usable
negatives.scope: One organism, and the reason is a property of THAT organism: M. tuberculosis is MONOMORPHIC and has no lineage-scale gap at Mash resolution (pairwise median 6.3e-4, p75 8.4e-4), so greedy collapse has only two regimes -- fine rungs barely merge (the clonality-INFLATED raw view) and coarse rungs blob (one cluster holds 77% of the cohort and 97% of labelled isolates fall into excluded mixed-label clusters). The pinned Napier BARCODE partition works fine on the same cohort and its numbers stand. This says nothing about Mash collapse on any non-monomorphic organism, where this project uses it routinely.
negatives.revival_condition: a lineage-collapse partition is needed for an organism WITH a lineage-scale gap at Mash resolution, or a marker-based barcode is unavailable for a monomorphic organism and a distance-based partition is the only option

negatives.claim: A RELATIVE RANKING rule over FBA conditional-essentiality ratios is worth building on the 25-source CARBON axis -- oracle ceiling +4 genes (+1.8pp)
negatives.scope: The best-measured axis (25 CARBON sources), scored as an ORACLE ceiling -- the most any such rule could achieve even given the answer. Three reasons, and they have DIFFERENT scopes, which is why the revival condition below is kept rather than dropped: (1) MEASURED, axis-specific -- the oracle ceiling is +4 genes / +1.8pp on carbon. (2) STRUCTURAL, axis-independent -- a deployable version must infer k (how many conditions a gene is essential in), which IS the original problem restated. This one needs no revival. (3) MECHANISM, but AXIS-MEASURED not axis-independent -- the conditional signal is essentially all HARD FEASIBILITY BREAKS, making it binary rather than graded, so a ranking rule has little to rank. A peer read this as foreclosing by mechanism and therefore needing no revival; that over-reads it. The 23/23 infeasibility finding is from `fba_conditional_carbon_2026-08-13.json` -- the CARBON axis -- and this project's own measurement is that FLATNESS TRACKS THE AXIS'S OWN DYNAMIC RANGE (CV 0.574 media4 / 0.473 carbon / 0.308 nitrogen, monotonic against flatness). So the binary-ness is plausibly a CONSEQUENCE of low dynamic range, and a higher-range axis could yield a graded signal.
negatives.revival_condition: an axis with greater dynamic range than carbon (measured CV 0.574 media4 / 0.473 carbon / 0.308 nitrogen) is available, OR a way to infer k that does not restate the original problem
negatives.scope_correction_reason: 2026-10-09 peer observation prompted separating the three reasons by scope. Reason (2) is axis-independent and needs no revival; reasons (1) and (3) are axis-measured, so the revival condition is retained.
negatives.structural_reason: A DEPLOYABLE ranking rule must infer k (how many conditions a gene is essential in), which IS the original problem restated. That holds on any axis and any substrate -- it is a property of the method's own formulation, not of the surface measured. The record's other two reasons (oracle ceiling; binary-not-graded signal) are AXIS-MEASURED on carbon and are retained as support only.
negatives.revival_kept_despite_exemption: The STRUCTURAL exemption permits omitting a revival condition; it does not require it, and one is kept here on purpose. A structural obstacle can still be REVIVED -- not by changing the surface measured, but by SOLVING the obstacle: 'a way to infer k that does not restate the original problem' is exactly that. So the two revival clauses do different jobs -- the axis clause serves the measured reasons, and the infer-k clause serves the structural one.
